title: Invitation (challenge) state diagram
description: One row of the D1 table challenges: an invitation from a signed-in player to an email address, whether or not anyone has signed in with it yet. It is answered at most once: closeChallenge only updates a row whose status is still open, so a second answer, from any route, gets 409 "The challenge was already answered." The lobby lists only open invitations, both ways; GET challenges/{id} shows any status to its sender or addressee.
machine: challenges.status (worker/schema.sql), written by worker/db.ts for worker/api.ts

states.description: Inserted by POST challenges with the challenger's colour (white, black or random); emailed through Resend when that is set up, and the challenger gets the link ?challenge=ID either way. At most 30 per sender per hour (429 beyond), and not to the sender's own address.
The addressee accepted: game_id names the online game it started.

transitions.guard: the signed-in player's email is the one it was sent to
transitions.action: closeChallenge(id, accepted, new game id); resolve a random colour with a random bit; insert the online game with its start entry; make each player the other's contact; answer with the game.

transitions.guard: the signed-in player's email is the one it was sent to
from a player it wasn't sent by or to, or an answer the player may not give (accepting or declining one's own, cancelling another's)
transitions.action: 403 for a stranger, 404 for the wrong answer; nothing changes.
